recipe.name: Corn Cheese Pasta (स्वीट कॉर्न पास्ता)
directions: In a pot add water, salt and bring it to a boil, then add pasta and boil it according to the time written on the packet.
Remove and strain all the water and apply some oil on the pasta and keep aside for further use.
In a pan add milk, cloves, black pepper cons and bring it to a boil.
In another pan add butter, refined flour and cook it on low heat until fragrant.
Now strain the milk in the flour mixture and mix it properly without forming lumps.
Then continue cooking until cooked or semi thick.
Switch off the flames and strain it again in a bowl and add some butter on it and keep aside for further use.
In a pan heat olive oil then add onion, garlic, green chilli and saute for translucent.
Now add corn sautÃ© for a minute and add some water, salt, prepared white sauce, boiled pasta and mix everything properly and cook for 2 minutes on medium heat.
Then add grated cheese, oregano, black pepper powder, mix and serve hot in a plate and garnish with oregano.
